title: CVA: Context-aware Video-text Alignment for Video Temporal Grounding

problems.name: Cross-Modal Semantic Alignment Gap
problems.evidence_sentence: CVA: Context-aware Video-text Alignment for Video Temporal Grounding We propose Context-aware Video-text Alignment (CVA), a novel framework to address a significant challenge in video temporal grounding: achieving temporally sensitive video-text alignment that remains robust to irrelevant background context. %CVA integrates complementary data-centric and architectural innovations to enhance contextual robustness.

problems.name: Boundary Ambiguity and Localization Precision
problems.evidence_sentence: Second, we introduce the Context-invariant Boundary Discrimination (CBD) loss, a contrastive loss that enforces semantic consistency at challenging temporal boundaries, making their representations robust to contextual shifts and hard negatives.
